title: Product-demo link strip
purpose: One centred pill link that sends the visitor to the product demo.

content.budgetRule: Budgets are COUNTS measured from the rendered clone at 1440 and 390 (extraction/measured-values.json copyBudgetExtractor); copy itself is never stored. maxWords/maxChars = the maximum observed across every route that renders this section; list sizes = observed min/max. Shorter is allowed; longer is rejected.

assets.note: reference mode may use referenceRoles (evidence); generated mode must use generatedRoles (generation-safe only, pinned in code). See assets/asset-roles.json.

style.note: token props take token-catalog names only (tokens/llm/token-catalog.json); allowed values per section are listed in tokens/llm/token-policy.json styleProps.
